decisions.statement: A caller asking here spells the key its page type declares.
A caller asking the plain composed query spells the key the store has.
A multi-word key asked the plain way is unmatched rather than refused.
A row narrowed to keys comes back empty where the spelling is dropped.
A browser takes this whole road.
Nothing here spells a key itself.
Nothing this road reaches opens a file.

definition: a composed query asked of the store in the spelling the store has
